name: Protect what must not be shared
description: Keep internal causes out of replies, and share account details only with a verified contact.
sourceMd:
1. Search the knowledge base and look up the organization.
2. Never mention internal system names or the cause of an incident in a reply.
3. Share details of the account only when the contact is verified.
4. Keep the reply short and polite.

steps.text: Keep the reply short and polite.
